`843-843`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Cover the `message.usage` merge when both `MessageStart` usage fields are set.** The new test sets only `message.usage` on `MessageStart`. The top-level `usage` branch at line 219 has no test coverage. In the current test, the nested merge at line 222 always starts with no counted tokens. No test runs that merge after the top-level merge has already recorded tokens. Add a test that sets `usage: Some(Usage { input_tokens: Some(25), output_tokens: Some(1) })` on both `MessageStart` fields. Assert `prompt_tokens == 25`, `completion_tokens == 1`, and `total_tokens == 26`. If the `message.usage` merge became additive, the totals would be 50, 2, and 52, and this test would fail.
